evidence_quote: ![](/a/assets/nojsimg.gif) ##### Quick Links # What to know about legionnaires' disease amid recent outbreaks in Ontario, N.Y. state ## Severe lung infection results from inhaling contaminated water spray ![](https://i.cbc.ca/ais/1.6481645,1654707471000/full/max/0/default.jpg?im=Crop%2Crect%3D%28953%2C0%2C3813%2C3813%29%3BResize%3D76) ![Text to Speech Icon](/a/assets/texttospeech.svg) ![Cooling towers are seen in the Harlem neighbourhood amid a legionnaires' disease outbreak in New York City, in August 2025.](https://i.cbc.ca/ais/1.7602659,1754511030000/full/max/0/default.jpg?im=Crop%2Crect%3D%280%2C130%2C7219%2C4060%29%3B) ## Social Sharing Legionnaires' disease has been in the headlines on both sides of the border this summer, with public health officials investigating outbreaks in Ontario and neighbouring New York state. A July outbreak in London, Ont., which has [since been declared over](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/london/legionnaires-outbreak-in-london-over-but-source-is-still-a-mystery-1.7602198), left four people dead and infected about 100 others. The [likely source](https://www.cbc.ca/news/health/legionnaires-outbreak-london-source-1.7621817) of the outbreak was the [cooling towers of a local meat-processing plant](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/london/legionnaires-outbreak-london-likely-source-1.7618150) in the city's east end, local health officials said. A recent outbreak in [New York City](https://apnews.com/article/legionnaires-disease-new-york-harlem-e509d666283abb9e22492a374c62c9f5), meanwhile, killed seven people and sickened dozens more. Health officials in that city link the Central Harlem outbreak to cooling towers — structures containing water and a fan that are used to cool buildings.
